content_trends.trend: Bottleneck sa presunul z generovania kodu na review a governance
content_trends.evidence: Ciklum (Faros AI +91 % review time), STRV (three-layer system), SudoLabs (Spec-Driven Development), Ackee (ADLC adopcia)
content_trends.implication_for_gr: Teza 'AI pod dohladom senior expertov' je konsenzus, nie pozicia. Diferencovat sa da uz len dokazom.

content_trends.trend: 'AI-native vs AI-assisted' sa stava nakupnym kriteriom; Vacuumlabs pise scorecard
content_trends.evidence: vacuumlabs.com clanok 'How to Tell If a Delivery Partner Is AI-Native or Just AI-Assisted' + /how-we-work-with-ai; globalne BlastAsia benchmarky (3 tyzdne do prvej dodavky, 43-77 % ceny)
content_trends.implication_for_gr: 'AI-Augmented' znie ako slabsia polovica cudzieho frameworku. Ram treba prepisat, nie v nom sutazit.

content_trends.trend: Pojmenovane frameworky a produktizovane CTA namiesto 'kontaktujte nas'
content_trends.evidence: Ciklum AI Strategy Clinic + 90-day roadmap; STRV three-layer + RODES + /agentic-engineering; SudoLabs Spec-Driven Development; Vacuumlabs 9 gated whitepaperov
content_trends.implication_for_gr: GR nema pojmenovany citovatelny asset ani produktizovane CTA - opravitelne ramovanim existujucej praxe.

content_trends.trend: Regulovane vertikaly s prevadzkovymi cislami = najsilnejsi case-study format
content_trends.evidence: Touch4IT HIPAA/SOC 2 (1M+ Medicaid, 72 % redukcia nakladov, 6 rokov); Applifting (69->92 %, 10x cena); Zentity ma bankovy material bez enginu
content_trends.implication_for_gr: Vo fintech/banking vertikale format nie je obsadeny - priestor pre GR.

content_trends.trend: Opakujuce sa datovane formaty ako lacna cadencia
content_trends.evidence: Futured mesacne rubriky (B2B digitalni prehled, App News); ui42 3-dielna seria + newsjacking vendor updatov
content_trends.implication_for_gr: Pre regulovany fintech to nerobi nikto - Regulated Delivery Digest.

content_trends.trend: Stat-stacking z cudzich zdrojov; nikto nepublikuje vlastne delivery data s metodikou
content_trends.evidence: SudoLabs (Gartner/MIT/Forrester/Nucleus), Ciklum (2,5 bil. USD, 39 %, 4x, 65 %), STRV (Gartner 40 %), Vacuumlabs (vlastne cisla bez metodiky)
content_trends.implication_for_gr: Kto prvy zverejni vlastne data s metodikou, ziska nekopirovatelnu citovatelnost.

content_trends.trend: NEWSJACKING GAP: EU AI Act 2.8.2026 - transparencne povinnosti (cl. 50) platia, high-risk odlozeny na 2.12.2027
content_trends.evidence: Digital Omnibus: navrh Komisie 19.11.2025 -> predbezna dohoda 7.5.2026 -> EP 16.6.2026 -> Rada EU green light 29.6.2026. Annex III -> 2.12.2027, Annex I -> 2.8.2028. Sankcie 15 mil. EUR / 3 %. Grace pre synteticky obsah uvedeny pred 2.8. -> 2.12.2026.
content_trends.implication_for_gr: Ani jedna SK/CZ firma zo sledovaneho zoznamu o tom nepublikovala. Na trhu je aktivny zmatok (napr. patechlabs stale tvrdi high-risk k 2.8.2026). Cisty gap s deadlinom.

content_trends.trend: DORA x AI Act delta - nikto v SK/CZ; cl. 14 doslova opisuje GR poziciu
content_trends.evidence: AI Act pridava nad DORA: cl. 10 data governance vratane biasu, cl. 9 model risk cez lifecycle, cl. 14 human oversight by design, cl. 49/71 registracia v EU databaze. PSD3 preberá DORA odkazom.
content_trends.implication_for_gr: Clanok 14 = GR pozicia zapisana do zakona. Zavazny je dokaz (tech dokumentacia, logovane rozhodnutia, zive zaznamy risk managementu) = output Secure SDLC.

H2: 'AI-assisted' sa stane pejorativom a 'AI-native' default narokom -> GR musi pojem AI-Augmented Delivery aktivne obhajit.
H3: Case studies s prevadzkovymi cislami maju vo fintechu vyssi efekt nez AI thought leadership.
H4: Recurring datovany format prekona jednorazove hlbkove clanky v celkovom vykone (Futured vzor) - overit po 3 cislach.
H5 (NEOVERENE, potrebuje LinkedIn pristup): CEO-led obsah (STRV Lubo Smid, Futured Lukas Strnadel, Panaxeo Igor Liska) ma vyssi engagement nez firemny profil.
